svg.title: Two layers of the same defence — DPIP and Krediwall

text.tspan: Two layers of the same defence
India’s shared fraud-intelligence platform and an open-source lender-side decision engine, side by side
Prototype built by the RBI Innovation Hub; operationalised by
IDPIC (Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation), a Section
Fraud firewall for credit-funded UPI payments in India — where a
fraudulent push-and-final payment is lost lender capital.
Answered with shared intelligence across institutions

Real-time pre-transaction risk scores returned to
SEES WHAT ONLY THE LENDER HOLDS
Plus national feeds — FRI digests, keyed-HMAC. No raw
identifiers at rest; nothing leaves the perimeter.
Institutions contribute fraud signals; connected risk context
flows back; each institution keeps its own controls and
Limit, burn and line age are
DPIP answers who is risky. Krediwall answers what this transaction is doing to this credit line right now.
Independent open-source project — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by RBI, RBIH, IDPIC or NPCI.
